sources: MacCarron, Kaski & Dunbar (2016), Calling Dunbar's numbers, Social Networks 47, 151–155 (arXiv:1604.02400) – ~6 billion calls among ~35 million people (one European country, 2007); call frequency revealed layers of about 4.1, 11.0, 29.8 and 128.9 people.
Zhou, Sornette, Hill & Dunbar (2005), Discrete hierarchical organization of social group sizes, Proc. R. Soc. B 272, 439–444 – the classic 5 / 15 / 50 / 150 layers.
